mission: Build a fractal Google Maps of law for Swiss Federal Supreme Court case law from 2000 onward plus user-imported corpora, beating simple semantic-map baselines in legal usefulness.

corpus.question: Scale the canonical TF-2000+ acquisition/normalization pipeline from current 1,577 decisions (1000 slice + 250 yearly core 2020-2024) to full coverage (2000-2024, ~192k decisions) via OpenCaseLaw bulk ingestion. Build citation ID resolution pipeline (BGE/ATF → corpus decision_id) to unlock citation role modeling integration at full corpus scale. Implement robust user corpus import with schema validation and map artifact persistence. Critical: full corpus density required to resolve 2,180 BGE/ATF citations for production-scale citation role modeling.

legal-distance.question: (1) Cross-lingual alignment / language dominance: TARGET ACHIEVED via zero-shot cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 (LangDom=0.4911 < 0.6, JuristPref=0.7990, both gates PASS, fractal ImpRate=84.9%). GPU fine-tuning of multilingual-e5-small now OPTIONAL enhancement (pretrained achieves best adversarial scores LangDom=0.4877, JP=0.7017 but catastrophic hierarchy collapse — needs hierarchy preservation loss). (2) Citation role modeling: UNLOCKED in legal-distance v7 — 2,988 role annotations 100% resolved via BGE/ATF pipeline; 3 roles validated (citing, following, criticizing) PASS adversarial gates. NOT blocked on corpus lane. (3) Jurist pairwise evaluation: Framework COMPLETE (200 questions, UI, sampling, analysis) — needs 5-10 Swiss jurists. (4) Benchmark refinement: Frozen harness v3 (seed=42, config_hash=1674829901d55e83) stable & reproducible. VALIDATED BASELINES (frozen harness v3): center_projected_64dim (JP=0.512, LangDom=0.766), linear_metric_epoch4 (JP=0.6847, LangDom=0.673), mahalanobis_metric_epoch4 (JP=0.6781, LangDom=0.678), hybrid_stabilized_epoch1 (JP=0.6656, LangDom=0.660), cited_decisions_tfidf (JP=0.6922, LangDom=0.6107 — ZERO-SHOT), cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 (JP=0.7990, LangDom=0.4911 — BEST PRODUCTION HYBRID, ZERO-SHOT, NO GPU), cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.7 (JP=0.7907, LangDom=0.4907 — BEST FRACTAL). BOILERPLATE RESISTANCE CORRECTION CONFIRMED (REPRODUCED): Real test shows 89-93% neighbor preservation when boilerplate removed — boilerplate NOT driving neighbors. v3 'boilerplate_resistance' proxy MISNAMED; measured language dominance (cross-lingual alignment failure). SYSTEMIC CHALLENGE IS CROSS-LINGUAL ALIGNMENT / LANGUAGE DOMINANCE, NOT BOILERPLATE. Target LangDom < 0.6 ACHIEVED by zero-shot hybrids.

fractal-map.question: EXTEND validated hierarchical Leiden map to ALL 12 breakthrough representations passing fractal quality validation (v8 REPRODUCED): (a) Metric Learning family — linear_metric_epoch4 (Fine=0.9754, NMI=0.5921, ImpRate=75.6%), mahalanobis_metric_epoch4 (Fine=0.9746, NMI=0.5944, ImpRate=71.4%), hybrid_stabilized_epoch1 (Fine=0.9638, NMI=0.5788, ImpRate=73.8%) — HIGH PURITY pattern; (b) Citation/Outcome family — cited_decisions_tfidf (ImpRate=97.1%, HierAdv=+0.1415), cited_outcome_hybrid_0.5 (ImpRate=86.8%, HierAdv=+0.2918, BEST PRODUCTION), cited_outcome_hybrid_0.7 (ImpRate=90.3%, HierAdv=+0.3703, BEST FRACTAL) — HIGH ADVANTAGE pattern; (c) Citation Role family — following_alpha0.3 (ImpRate=82.2%, Fine=0.9501), criticizing_alpha0.3 (Fine=0.9619, HierAdv=+0.0815), citing_alpha0.3 (ImpRate=66.9%). center_projected_hierarchical REPRODUCED as DEFAULT (nesting=1.0, purity=0.9571/0.9718, 7-res ladder, 108 clusters). Expose TWO design patterns as selectable map modes: High-Purity (Metric Learning) vs High-Advantage (Citation/Outcome). Scale fractal map to full corpus (192k) once corpus lane delivers.

evaluation.question: Next cycle (v9) on expanded/full corpus using adversarial benchmarks: (1) Full corpus scale evaluation (192k decisions) — validate metric learning representations at production scale, test scale stability on full corpus, evaluate fractal map quality at production scale; (2) Citation role modeling evaluation — evaluate 2,988 role annotations (citing, following, criticizing) against adversarial gates on frozen harness; (3) Legal embeddings fine-tuning evaluation — test multilingual-e5-small fine-tuned with hierarchy preservation loss on Swiss legal corpus, evaluate multilingual invariance with coarse legal structure, compare against center_projected_64dim baseline; (4) Jurist human study (framework ready) — execute pairwise preference study with 5-10 Swiss jurists, validate simulated jurist proxy against real jurist judgments, test map mode preferences (High-Purity vs High-Advantage vs Citation Role views); (5) Cross-lingual alignment deeper investigation — test if metric learning representations improve language invariance beyond zero-shot hybrids, evaluate section-specific embeddings (sachverhalt, erwaegungen, dispositiv) for cross-lingual coherence; (6) User corpus import evaluation — validate map artifacts persist correctly for user-imported corpora, test recomputation triggers and incremental updates, evaluate schema validation robustness. v8 EXTENDED COMPLETED: 4 new representations pass BOTH adversarial gates (multilingual_e5_small_pretrained, cited_decisions_tfidf_proc_pairs, cited_decisions_tfidf_joint_pca, cited_decisions_tfidf_mean_center); proc_pairs best cross-lingual cited_decisions variant (Jurivoc L0=0.3133 PASS, cross-lang=0.2083 PASS). All 11 total representations passing both gates cataloged.

Add jurist feedback capture endpoints, prepare for full corpus map persistence. User corpus import and map export operational.
